summary: On-demand evidence packet for Privacy Impact Assessment: encrypted SIEM sample, session index, and entity reconciliation map
description: Issue summary: IntegralBank (enterprise) is conducting a Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) and requires a bundled evidence packet demonstrating Redwood's audit and SIEM export capabilities, plus an identity reconciliation artefact for a bounded production window. Impact: customer cannot complete regulator PIA until evidence is provided; request is on the critical path for contract renewal. Requested timeframe: 72-hour delivery for initial sample; full packet within 5 business days.
requested_deliverables: Encrypted S3 snapshot (AES-256-GCM) containing NDJSON SIEM export for window 2026-02-15T00:00:00Z to 2026-02-15T06:00:00Z
Signed manifest (SHA-256 checksums) and RFC3161 timestamp for the snapshot
Session index CSV mapping session_id -> first_seen_ts -> last_seen_ts with event counts
Entity reconciliation map: per-tenant identifier mapping (pseudonymized) and reversible-pseudonymization proof using HSM-attested key split
Field-level redaction report showing which fields were redacted and redaction rationale (PII vs. metadata)
Compact runbook snippet explaining how the snapshot was generated, filters used, and resume-token semantics
Completed PIA questionnaire answers (customer-facing Q&A) referencing the above artifacts
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer provided legal PO and data sharing agreement; 2) Support to trigger on-demand export job with provided filters; 3) Generate session index and reconciliation map; 4) Package and sign artifacts; 5) Deliver encrypted bundle to presigned S3 URL and provide decryption instructions and verification checksums.
